notes.title: Major Update: "A Night With: Spirit" Remastered Now Live!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

We're thrilled to announce that "A Night With: Spirit" has received a major update! What's New:

- Remade Sprites and H-Scenes: All sprites and h-scenes have been completely redone;
- All fours Scene: We've added a brand-new scene with Mira to bring more variety your encounters;
- Improved Gameplay and UI: We've polished the game for a better experience.
- Updated User Interface: Navigating through the game is now easier and more intuitive than ever.

We'd love to hear your thoughts on the remaster! Share your experiences, feedback, or any issues you encounter in the community discussions. Your input helps us continue to improve.
